collectors.validationNote: Official network tariff is 0.38 EUR/kWh plus 0.01 EUR/min for sessions started 20:00-04:00 or 0.02 EUR/min for sessions started 04:00-20:00. The collector binds that exact compound tariff to all current BNetzA EVSE IDs operated by eze.network; latest workflow validation produced 736 EVSE entries.

Official Connect Me power-tier tariff is mapped only where the BNetzA EVSE power fits an exact published tier: 0.49 EUR/kWh AC <=49 kW, 0.57 EUR/kWh DC 50-75 kW, 0.69 EUR/kWh HPC 76-400 kW. Latest workflow validation produced 900 exact EVSE entries from 972 Mer BNetzA site rows; remaining points stay visible and unpriced rather than extrapolated.

policy: Collectors with status active_validated count as completely treated. Collectors with status active_partial count as partially treated only when their exact station/EVSE output has passed its dedicated workflow; uncovered points remain unpriced. Failing collectors remain outside the treated counter.
